purpose: Teach: 本島/丹波/三条/名護/代々木/松戸/加賀/小田原

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが沖縄本島、つまり本島へ新婚旅行された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he took his honeymoon to Okinawa's main island, didn't he…
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle rhythm of memory. A question posed as tender certainty—not seeking confirmation but inviting her back to that moment with him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、京都丹波の黒豆を取り寄せされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and when you were young, your grandfather had those black beans from Tamba, Kyoto sent specially to us, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, playful redirect. Light, knowing tone—she's matching his nostalgia but gently steering to her own memory. Affectionate address on 'dear.' Slight lilt at the end, drawing him in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新潟県三条市の打刃物を蒐集された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected fine-bladed tools from Sanjo in Niigata…
lines.style: Same wistful anchor. Quieter this time—he's deeper in memory. Slight pause before the city names, as if turning pages in his mind. Specific, tender precision.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、沖縄県名護市に出張されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather went on a business trip to Nago, Okinawa when he was young, remember? You used to tell me about it, dear.
lines.style: Gently persistent. She's not letting him drift entirely into his own past—she's weaving their stories together. Warm but with a touch of 'I was there too.' Tender close on the final 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが東京代々木のオリンピック観戦された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he watched the Olympics at Yoyogi in Tokyo…
lines.style: Same wistful thread continuing. A rhythm settling in now—almost meditative. He's building a catalogue of moments. Voice steady, almost reverent with specificity.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、千葉県松戸市の社宅にお住まいだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you lived in the company housing in Matsudo, Chiba when you were young, didn't you, dear? You loved that neighborhood.
lines.style: She's matching his catalogue-building but making it mutual. Warm affection threaded through. A slight rise of certainty—she knows this. Intimate address on 'dear.' She's holding their shared history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが石川県加賀温泉に毎年行かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he went every year to the hot springs in Kaga, Ishikawa…
lines.style: The wistfulness has deepened into something quieter, almost sacred. The rhythm is established now—he's speaking like a man cataloguing the small treasures of a life. Patient, specific, tender.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、神奈川県小田原のかまぼこをお取り寄せされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather always had kamaboko from Odawara, Kanagawa sent to us when you were young—didn't he spoil us that way, dear?
lines.style: Her voice has softened to match his reverence. She's no longer redirecting—she's dancing with him now. Warm, intimate, slightly teasing about the indulgence. Close with deep affection on the final 'dear.'
